description: This plot illustrates the relationship between Loss and Training Time (s) for two different configurations, one of which is labeled "SepLLM". The x-axis represents Training Time (s) on a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 250,000 with tick marks at regular intervals of 50,000. The y-axis represents Loss on a linear scale, ranging from 2.40 to 2.75 with tick marks at regular intervals of 0.05. The plot features two solid lines that both demonstrate a steep initial decline followed by a gradual leveling off. The first line is purple with upward-pointing triangle markers, corresponding to a redacted legend entry. Its first visible marker appears at approximately 25,000 seconds with a loss of 2.69, and it declines steadily to end at a loss of exactly 2.50 at 250,000 seconds. The second line is red with circular markers, labeled "SepLLM". Its first visible marker appears at approximately 15,000 seconds with a loss of 2.71, and it declines to a final value of approximately 2.49 at 235,000 seconds. Additionally, the plot includes green dashed annotations: a horizontal line at a loss of 2.50, and two vertical lines dropping to the x-axis from the points where each solid line intersects the 2.50 loss level. The red line intersects this level at approximately 195,000 seconds, marked by a green star, while the purple line intersects it at 250,000 seconds, also marked by a green star. A green double-headed arrow spans the horizontal distance between these two vertical lines, accompanied by the text "1.26$\times$".
